description:
The Fuzz has been both flipped and proved itself in the racing environment, taking podiums at major DH and Freeride events worldwide. It's been ridden at the WC by UR Team riders like George Brannigan, Kye A'hern, Tegan Cruz and many other fast riders on a national level. From 2018 the frame has been constatntly improving and through the years undergone a major overhaul which includes revised geometry (yes... longer, lower, slacker!), chain stay lengths proportional to the frame size and adjustable reach thanks to the special eccentric headset. The Fuzz frameset comes fitted with the new FOX Performance Float X2 shock.
MAIN FEATURES
- truly modern DH geometry: low, long and slack
- 4-bar Horst link suspension w/ a fair amount of antisquat
- progressive leverage ratio curve
- suspension is immune to brake jack
- shock is tucked away near the BB for low center of gravity
- 1.5’’ head tube with reach adjustable offset cups
- CS lengths now proportional to the frame size for a perfectly balanced ride
- neat gusset connecting the top tube with the seat tube
- available in two sizes
- FOX Performance Float X2 shock

components.description: FOX Performance Float X2 shock, 9.5”x3.0” (240x76mm), mounting hardware: front 30 x 8 mm, rear 22.2 x 8mm
34.9mm, CNC alloy seat post clamp included
